gaps.required_work: Add a schema-validated loader for an independently labeled retrieval corpus, dataset provenance, deterministic split/replay semantics, and tests against malformed/incomplete labels.

Add an adapter that creates or connects to a disposable vector index, runs competing namespace/filter/reranker/top-k policies, captures actual retrieved results, and converts them into replay observations without claiming proprietary Pinecone access.

Persist full experiment provenance and replay artifacts as a versioned machine receipt, including dataset digest, policy definitions, retrieval trace digest, outcome labels, selected policy, command/version metadata, and reproducibility instructions.
